svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Linux host baseline: from fresh guest to workload-ready
Six steps in three layers, each gated by a check; the host then joins the fleet before it carries anything
What you bring: a hostname, address, gateway, DNS server and time zone; the administrative username, dkadi; three approved ED25519 public keys
Proxmox console open, no workload yet
dnf upgrade -y on the RHEL family
sudo asks for a password, no NOPASSWD
one approved ED25519 key per line
root keeps a password and answers every sudo prompt, but cannot log in over SSH; a stolen key or a stolen login password alone is not root
PermitRootLogin no, both password methods off
passwd root, proven with su - first
Only the unattended ansible account carries NOPASSWD; a human account never does. Every Linux guest ends up here
apt or dnf runs from Semaphore
three approved keys stay the baseline
its sudo entry answers the prompt
Workload-ready · what the checks must show
id dkadi lists sudo; sudo -n true exits 1, because a person at a keyboard is asked for a password
sudo -l -U dkadi, run as root, lists rootpw among the Defaults and no NOPASSWD
sshd -T: permitrootlogin no, pubkeyauthentication yes, passwordauthentication no, kbdinteractiveauthentication no
ssh-keygen -lf authorized_keys prints exactly three fingerprints; passwd -S root reports P; a wrong password is refused at the sudo prompt
timedatectl and locale report America/New_York and en_US.UTF-8
the workload waits until the patch transaction exits 0
dkadi is in sudo and exactly three fingerprints are present
sshd -t passes, a second key-only session connects, su - proved root's password before 00-rootpw landed
agent active on the manager, target UP in Prometheus, host in the fleet inventory

Until 2026-08-15 root was locked here; the current model gives root a password that the sudo prompt asks for, so the login password and the sudo password are different values. Windows hosts follow separate records.
Source: Guides/Linux-Host-Baseline.md, Guides/SSH-Key-Lifecycle.md, Platforms/Wazuh/Configuration/README.md, Platforms/Prometheus/README.md, Platforms/Ansible/README.md
